metadata.database_name: EDM Masterclass Group 3: French Touch, Synthwave, Electro & Cyberpunk (Artists 41-60)
metadata.compiled_by: Music Scholar 3: French Touch, Synthwave, Electro & Cyberpunk Billboard Specialist

artists.name: Daft Punk
artists.billboard_peak: Billboard Hot 100 #2 ('Get Lucky'), 4x Multi-Platinum, 2x Grammy Awards (Record of the Year, Best Pop Duo/Group); 'One More Time' peaked #61 Hot 100 / #1 Billboard Dance Club Songs; 'Around The World' #1 Dance Club Songs.

harmonic_progression.title: Get Lucky
harmonic_progression.roman_numerals: i7 - bIII - v7 - IV (in B Dorian)
harmonic_progression.analysis: Modal Dorian loop anchored by the raised 6th degree (G# in E9), avoiding the functional dominant F#7 to maintain hypnotic, unending disco cycle. Common-tone voice leading centers on F#4 and A4.

topline_melody.title: Get Lucky / One More Time
topline_melody.contour_type: Syncopated pentatonic arch with octave falsetto leaps

climax.lyric: We're up all night to get lucky

topline_melody.vocoder_elements: In 'One More Time' and 'Harder Better Faster Stronger', Digitech Vocalist II & Antares Auto-Tune pitch correction set to 0ms retune speed, feeding Ensoniq ASR-10 sampler.

bass_groove.title: Nathan East Slap / Moog French Pumping Bass
bass_groove.patch: Fender Precision Bass / Minimoog Model D dual saw
bass_groove.pocket: Nathan East live slap thumb-thump on beat 1 with syncopated 16th pops on the offbeat, ducked 12dB under 4-on-the-floor kick via Alesis 3630 sidechain.

timbral_profile.tape_saturation: Studer A800 2-inch 24-track tape saturation at 15 IPS for head-bump low-end warmth (60-120Hz +2.5dB). ChowTape hysteresis drive at 0.42.
timbral_profile.hardware_gear: Alesis 3630 compressor (fast attack, 50ms release, 8:1 ratio), Roland Juno-106, Minimoog, Oberheim OB-Xa, E-mu SP-1200, Ensoniq ASR-10.
timbral_profile.spatial_acoustics: EMT 140 plate reverb on vocal bus (1.8s decay, pre-delay 24ms), Lexicon 480L Hall on synths, dry punchy centered kick and slap bass.

macro_structure.buildup_mechanism: 16-bar low-pass sweep un-filtering rhythm section from 250Hz to 18kHz; 32-bar drumless breakdown isolating vocal vocoder harmonies; beat 4 bar 32 full-stop impact turnaround.

artists.name: Justice
artists.billboard_peak: Billboard Hot Dance/Electronic Songs #1 ('Neverender', 2024); 'D.A.N.C.E.' #10 Hot Dance/Electronic Songs, Grammy-nominated; *Cross* certified Gold globally.

harmonic_progression.title: Genesis / D.A.N.C.E.
harmonic_progression.roman_numerals: i - bVI - bVII - i (Genesis) / i7 - iv7 - bVII7 - bIIImaj7 (D.A.N.C.E.)
harmonic_progression.analysis: Grinding baroque counterpoint meets heavy metal cadences. Uses heavy unison brass stabs on root notes coupled with dissonant leading-tone resolutions.

topline_melody.title: D.A.N.C.E. / Genesis Fanfare
topline_melody.contour_type: Disjunct juvenile choir fanfare with octave leaps
topline_melody.vocoder_elements: Children choir samples heavily compressed and spliced with micro-edits in GarageBand/Cubase; Genesis uses pitch-dive monosynth with intense LFO pitch vibrato.

bass_groove.title: Distorted Micro-Sliced Slap Bass
bass_groove.patch: Overdriven Fender Jazz Bass sliced into Cubase sampler + Korg MS-20 square sub
bass_groove.pocket: In-your-face quantized 16th-note slap pops with high-mid clank (2.5kHz boost) and aggressive gating on beat 4 for absolute silence.

timbral_profile.tape_saturation: Marshall guitar amp head overdrive emulation, extreme digital clipping, 12-bit bitcrushing, Soundtoys Decapitator Style T (Triode) driven +6dB.
timbral_profile.hardware_gear: Korg MS-20, Roland Juno-106, GarageBand acoustic drum kits smashed with brickwall limiters, SSL 4000 console distortion.
timbral_profile.spatial_acoustics: Non-linear gated snare reverb with 180ms cut, dry mono center for bass and kick, wide stereo choir and synth horns.

macro_structure.buildup_mechanism: Orchestral horn and slap bass unison calls; total muting of master stereo bus on beat 4 of bar 16 ('choke turnaround') before exploding into the drop.

artists.name: Gesaffelstein
artists.subgenre: Dark Electro / Industrial Techno / Midtempo Cyberpunk
top_tracks: Lost in the Fire (with The Weeknd)
artists.billboard_peak: Billboard Hot 100 #27 ('Lost in the Fire'), #3 Hot Dance/Electronic Songs; *Aleph* critically lauded worldwide as the blueprint for industrial dark electro.

harmonic_progression.title: Opr / Pursuit
harmonic_progression.roman_numerals: i - bII - i - bVI (Phrygian tension)
harmonic_progression.analysis: Severe, brutalist minimalism. The semitone collision between D and Eb generates visceral industrial anxiety, resolving to a static low-frequency pedal point.

topline_melody.title: Opr Industrial Ostinato
topline_melody.contour_type: Repetitive mechanical 16th siren motif with microtonal pitch bends
topline_melody.vocoder_elements: In 'Lost in the Fire', The Weeknd's intimate R&B topline is contrasted against pitch-shifted, formant-lowered robotic whisper textures.

bass_groove.title: Brutalist Midtempo 16th Saw Pulse
bass_groove.patch: Sequential Circuits Pro-One / Roland SH-101 saw wave through moog ladder filter
bass_groove.pocket: Strict, relentless machine pulse at 106 BPM with polyrhythmic 3-3-3-3-4 accent velocity tiers driving a crushing 4-on-the-floor kick.

timbral_profile.tape_saturation: Thermionic Culture Vulture triode distortion on drum and bass buses; ChowTape wow/flutter zeroed, tape bias hot +3dB.
timbral_profile.hardware_gear: Arturia MatrixBrute, Moog Sub Phatty, Roland TR-909 kick tuned down 3 semitones and clipped, Empirical Labs Distressor in 'Nuke' mode.
timbral_profile.spatial_acoustics: Ultra-dry claustrophobic acoustic space; synthetic gated white-noise bursts substituting for traditional reverbs.

macro_structure.buildup_mechanism: Continuous 32-bar filter cutoff escalation without melodic variation; sudden 1-beat vacuum silence before devastating full-frequency impact.

artists.name: Kavinsky
artists.billboard_peak: Global streaming & chart juggernaut; 'Nightcall' multi-platinum international hit (*Drive* soundtrack), #1 Shazam global in 2024 (Paris Olympics ceremony), 1B+ streams.

harmonic_progression.title: Nightcall
harmonic_progression.roman_numerals: i - bVI - bIII - bVII (Heroic / Nostalgic Cadence)
harmonic_progression.analysis: The quintessential outrun chord cycle. Uses luscious minor 7th and major 7th voicings producing a bittersweet nighttime driving atmosphere.

topline_melody.title: Nightcall Robotic Vocoder / Ethereal Counterpoint
topline_melody.contour_type: Monotone deadpan vocoder verse answered by soaring female falsetto arch
topline_melody.vocoder_elements: Sennheiser VSM201 / EMS Vocoder 2000 emulation driven by a warm saw carrier, tuned to low A2/E3 with deliberate lack of vibrato for cyborg aesthetic.

bass_groove.title: Driving 80s Electro Pluck & Sub
bass_groove.patch: Sequential Prophet-5 brassy pluck layered with Roland Juno-60 sub-oscillator
bass_groove.pocket: Slow, heavy 86 BPM outrun pocket with 8th-note pulse and syncopated 16th pickups on beat 4-and.

timbral_profile.tape_saturation: ChowDSP tape machine emulation with 7.5 IPS saturation for warm high-frequency roll-off above 12kHz; tape hiss layer at -54dB.
timbral_profile.hardware_gear: Sequential Prophet-5, Roland Jupiter-8, LinnDrum LM-2 samples, AMS RMX16 Non-Lin 2 gated reverb on snare.
timbral_profile.spatial_acoustics: Gated 80s snare reverb with 450ms tail, lush stereo chorus on electric piano pads, dead-center dry vocoder.

macro_structure.buildup_mechanism: Ferrari Testarossa engine ignition intro; low-pass filter slowly unveiling the arpeggiator over 16 bars; drum turnaround with classic gated snare fill.

artists.name: Carpenter Brut
artists.billboard_peak: Top Dance/Electronic Albums top 10; *Trilogy* and *Leather Teeth* cult phenomena with 300M+ streams; featured on *Hotline Miami 2* soundtrack.

harmonic_progression.title: Turbo Killer / Roller Mobster
harmonic_progression.roman_numerals: i - bVI - bIII - bVII (with chromatic Thrash Metal insertions)
harmonic_progression.analysis: Blends 80s John Carpenter horror motifs with Iron Maiden / Judas Priest metal harmony, alternating between minor triads and sharp chromatic leading-tone dominants.

topline_melody.title: Turbo Killer Shredding Monosynth Solo
topline_melody.contour_type: Rapid scalar shredding with wide octave pitch-wheel scoops and vibrato
topline_melody.vocoder_elements: Vocal elements feature processed heavy-metal scream shouts and 80s stadium rock guest vocals (e.g. Mat McNerney).

bass_groove.title: The Carpenter Brut Gallop
bass_groove.patch: Korg MS-20 & Minimoog distorted saw waves passed through guitar amp simulator
bass_groove.pocket: The legendary heavy-metal galloping 16th bassline (16th + two 32nds or driving 16ths: Root-8va-Root-Root) over thunderous double-kick patterns.

timbral_profile.tape_saturation: SansAmp PSA-1 analog saturation and ChowTape pushed into extreme odd-harmonic overdrive; transient shaper boosting attack by +4dB.
timbral_profile.hardware_gear: Korg Polysix, Korg MS-20, Roland Juno-60, Dave Smith Mopho, Simmons electronic drum tom samples.
timbral_profile.spatial_acoustics: Massive Lexicon 224 Dark Plate on snare, metallic gunshot reverb impacts on transition downbeats.

macro_structure.buildup_mechanism: Pounding acoustic toms build into a false drop with solitary pitch-bent saw lead; sudden full explosion with thrash metal crash turnarounds.

artists.name: Perturbator
top_tracks: She Is Young, She Is Beautiful, She Is Next
artists.billboard_peak: Billboard Heatseekers #1; Billboard Top Dance/Electronic Albums top 10; *Dangerous Days* & *The Uncanny Valley* over 200M streams.

harmonic_progression.title: Future Club
harmonic_progression.roman_numerals: i - bVI - bIII - bVII (with modal shift to bII - i)
harmonic_progression.analysis: Dystopian cyberpunk aesthetic utilizing modal mixture between G Aeolian and G Phrygian (Ab major chord insertions). Creates bleak cyber-noir tension.

topline_melody.title: Future Club Cybernetic Ostinato
topline_melody.contour_type: Rapid 16th-note arpeggiated ostinato with screeching syncopated accents
topline_melody.vocoder_elements: Synthesized metallic choir pads (Roland Juno-60 chorus) paired with heavily distorted vocoder announcements.

bass_groove.title: Industrial 16th Resonant Drive
bass_groove.patch: Sequential Prophet-08 twin saw + Yamaha DX7 solid bass sub
bass_groove.pocket: Driving industrial 16th-note motor with aggressive resonance sweeping on the low-pass filter and sidechain ducking under an electronic 80s kick.

timbral_profile.tape_saturation: Analog tape warmth via ChowDSP at 15 IPS with high-frequency compression, Soundtoys Decapitator Style E (EMI console) pushed to crunch.
timbral_profile.hardware_gear: Dave Smith Prophet '08, Yamaha DX7, Oberheim Matrix-1000, Roland TR-707/TR-909 processed through guitar stompboxes.
timbral_profile.spatial_acoustics: Cold non-linear plate reverb, dark 2.4s decay cavern spaces, stereo widened synth brass.

macro_structure.buildup_mechanism: Blade Runner atmospheric synth drone intro; 16-bar industrial rhythm entry; sudden Gothic organ breakdown before final double-time turnaround.

artists.name: Danger
artists.billboard_peak: French Dance Charts; international soundtrack composer (*Furi*, *Haven*), 100M+ streams across viral electronic music communities.

harmonic_progression.title: 4h30
harmonic_progression.roman_numerals: i9 - IV7 - bVImaj7 - V7#9
harmonic_progression.analysis: Combines French Touch extended jazz harmony (m9, maj7, 7#9) with jagged chiptune and orchestral scoring, creating an anime/video-game boss-fight grandeur.

topline_melody.title: 4h30 8-Bit Chiptune / Orchestral Lead
topline_melody.contour_type: Rapid scalar 8-bit cascades alternating with long expressive pitch-bent violin-synth lines
topline_melody.vocoder_elements: Glitched speech-synthesizer phonemes and 8-bit DAC quantization noise bursts.

bass_groove.title: Slap-Ed Banger Glitch Bass
bass_groove.patch: Compressed electric slap bass sample layered with 12-bit square sub
bass_groove.pocket: Staccato 30% gate-length slap pops with micro-stutter edits (32nd note repeat bursts) and aggressive sidechain pumping.

timbral_profile.tape_saturation: ChowDSP tape machine emulation with extreme high bias and harmonic saturation; bitcrushing down to 10-bit / 22kHz on chiptune leads.
timbral_profile.hardware_gear: Nintendo Game Boy (LSDJ sound engine), Roland Alpha Juno, Korg M1 orchestral samples, Alesis 3630 compressor.
timbral_profile.spatial_acoustics: Surgically dry glitch transients contrasting with ultra-wide cinematic symphonic reverb halls (3.2s decay).

macro_structure.buildup_mechanism: Orchestral string tremolo build with accelerating chiptune clock; sudden 1-bar rhythmic glitch choke; devastating drop on beat 1.

artists.name: The Midnight
artists.billboard_peak: Billboard Top Dance/Electronic Albums #1 (*Monsters*, 2020); Billboard Heatseekers #2 (*Endless Summer*); 350M+ global streams.

harmonic_progression.title: Sunset
harmonic_progression.roman_numerals: IVmaj7 - V - vi7 - iii7 (The Golden Retro Cadence)
harmonic_progression.analysis: The emotional benchmark of modern synthwave. Avoids landing on the root tonic (Eb) during the chorus loop, creating endless nostalgic yearning that propels the sax and vocal hook.

topline_melody.title: Sunset Tenor Saxophone & Vocal Hook
topline_melody.contour_type: Soulful ascending melodic leap to high expressive climax with micro-pitch vibrato
topline_melody.vocoder_elements: Live tenor saxophone played with natural growl and breath resonance; vocal harmonies stacked in lush four-part 80s arena pop voicings.

bass_groove.title: 80s DX7 Slap / Analog Saw Pulse
bass_groove.patch: Yamaha DX7 'Bass 1' FM slap blended with Roland Juno-106 sub
bass_groove.pocket: Driving 80s 8th-note pulse with syncopated 16th-note octave jumps on the 'and' of beats 2 and 4.

timbral_profile.tape_saturation: Studer A800 tape warmth with gentle 15 IPS saturation, Roland Dimension D chorus (Mode 2) on synth pads, ChowTape smooth tone control.
timbral_profile.hardware_gear: Roland Juno-106 (Chorus II engaged), LinnDrum LM-2 snare and kick, Selmer Mark VI tenor saxophone, Neve 1073 preamp.
timbral_profile.spatial_acoustics: Gated 80s digital snare reverb (Lexicon 480L Gated Plate, 380ms cutoff), wide stereo saxophone chamber reverb.

macro_structure.buildup_mechanism: Verse intimate vocal with 8th-note bass; pre-chorus snare build with open hi-hat sizzle; explosive chorus drop led by tenor saxophone and gated snare hits.

artists.name: Gunship
artists.billboard_peak: UK Dance Albums #1; Billboard Top Dance/Electronic Albums #6; multi-million viral streaming and cult sci-fi hitmakers.

harmonic_progression.title: Tech Noir
harmonic_progression.roman_numerals: i - bVI - iv - bVII (Nostalgic Minor 7ths)
harmonic_progression.analysis: Cinematic film-score harmony utilizing minor 9th extensions and suspended 4th chords to evoke classic 1980s Ridley Scott / John Carpenter dystopian scapes.

topline_melody.title: Tech Noir Spoken Prologue / Vocal Arpeggio
topline_melody.contour_type: Intimate vocal whisper evolving into soaring anthemic octave hooks
topline_melody.vocoder_elements: John Carpenter iconic spoken monologue prologue, vocal doubles doubled with analog saw pad tracking the melody in octaves.

bass_groove.title: Moog Taurus Heavy Dystopian Drone
bass_groove.patch: Moog Taurus pedal sub layered with Prophet-6 analog pulse wave
bass_groove.pocket: Slow, colossal 88 BPM groove with heavy sub anchor on beat 1 and syncopated 16th-note bounce on beat 3-and.

timbral_profile.tape_saturation: ChowTape tape compression with +3.5dB input drive, classic 80s tape hiss bed, warm tube preamplification on vocal chain.
timbral_profile.hardware_gear: Sequential Prophet-6, Roland Jupiter-4, Moog Subsequent 37, Oberheim DMX drums with EMT 140 plate reverb.
timbral_profile.spatial_acoustics: Enormous cinematic soundstage with 4.5s delay-verb tails on vocal ad-libs; tightly centered sub-bass down to 30Hz.

macro_structure.buildup_mechanism: Spoken-word movie monologue over ambient pad; slow-burning verse into majestic, soaring chorus drop; guitar/synth duel solo turnaround.

artists.name: Com Truise
artists.billboard_peak: Billboard Top Electronic/Dance Albums top 10 (*Iteration*, *Persuasion System*); inventor of the 'mid-fi synth-wave' movement with 150M+ streams.

harmonic_progression.title: Memory Palace / Brond
harmonic_progression.roman_numerals: i7 - IV9 - bVImaj7 - bVII (Slow-Motion Funk Cadence)
harmonic_progression.analysis: Sophisticated jazz-funk harmony featuring 9th and 11th extensions. The major IV9 in Dorian provides a buoyant, weightless retro-futuristic glide.

topline_melody.title: Memory Palace Pitch-Wobbly Lead
topline_melody.contour_type: Warped analog monosynth with slow LFO pitch drift and syncopated pentatonic counterpoint
topline_melody.vocoder_elements: Chopped vocoder chords and vocoder formant filters modulated via slow sine wave LFOs (0.2 Hz).

bass_groove.title: Slow-Motion Funk Slap / Oberheim Groove
bass_groove.patch: Oberheim Matrix-6 / Roland Juno-106 with slow chorus and pitch drift
bass_groove.pocket: Heavy 58% MPC swing shuffle with delayed offbeat 16ths (+12ms) producing a laid-back, syrup-slow funk groove.

timbral_profile.tape_saturation: Extreme tape wow/flutter emulation (ChowTape with 0.35 depth, 0.4 Hz speed), tape degradation, saturation simulating warped 80s Type II chrome cassettes.
timbral_profile.hardware_gear: Oberheim Matrix-6, Roland Juno-106, Sequential Prophet-600, Linn 9000 drum machine, SP-404 vinyl simulator.
timbral_profile.spatial_acoustics: Gated dry snare with tight room ambience, wide chorus spread on pads, subtle mono spring reverb on leads.

macro_structure.buildup_mechanism: Polyrhythmic synth layers phased in 4-bar cycles; sudden tape-stop turnaround on beat 4 of bar 16 before dropping back into full slow-motion funk beat.

artists.name: Tycho
artists.billboard_peak: Grammy Nominee for Best Dance/Electronic Album (*Epoch*); Billboard Top Dance/Electronic Albums #1; 400M+ global streams.

harmonic_progression.title: Awake
harmonic_progression.roman_numerals: Imaj7 - IVmaj7 - vi7 - V (Pristine Organic Flow)
harmonic_progression.analysis: Warm, expansive modal harmony characterized by open-voiced major 7th and suspended chords that create an endless horizon of emotional nostalgia and serenity.

topline_melody.title: Awake Interlocking Guitar / Polysynth Hook
topline_melody.contour_type: Graceful ascending pentatonic arpeggios with tape delay cascades and subtle rubato
topline_melody.vocoder_elements: Clean Fender Stratocaster guitar through Strymon El Capistan tape delay interlocked with Roland Juno-60 polysynth arp.

bass_groove.title: Melodic Precision Bass / Moog Organic Pocket
bass_groove.patch: Fender Precision Bass (flatwound strings, thumb pluck) doubled with warm Moog sub
bass_groove.pocket: Organic humanized groove with laid-back 8th notes, subtle pitch slides, and melodic counterpoint rather than static root notes.

timbral_profile.tape_saturation: Analog tape warmth with gentle 15 IPS saturation via ChowTape; Neve 1073 console preamp emulation adding subtle second harmonics.
timbral_profile.hardware_gear: Moog Minimoog Model D, Roland Juno-60, Access Virus TI, Fender Stratocaster, live acoustic drum kit with warm ribbon room mics.
timbral_profile.spatial_acoustics: Strymon BigSky cloud reverb, vintage EMT 140 plate reverb, warm natural drum room acoustics (1.8s decay).

macro_structure.buildup_mechanism: Layer-by-layer acoustic/electronic instrumentation introduction across 32 bars; climax where guitar counter-melody soars over full drum groove; peaceful ambient fade.

artists.name: Boys Noize
artists.subgenre: Electro Clash / Industrial Techno / Acid Electro
artists.billboard_peak: Grammy Award Winner (Silk City / Dua Lipa 'Electricity'); Grammy Nominee for Best Dance/Electronic Recording; Billboard Hot Dance/Electronic Top 10.

harmonic_progression.title: & Down / Midnight
harmonic_progression.roman_numerals: i - bII - i - bVII (Heavy Industrial Power Chords)
harmonic_progression.analysis: Stripped-down, pummeling power-chord root-fifth structures that bypass traditional triads in favor of brutal, distorted industrial dissonance.

topline_melody.title: & Down Acid TB-303 Screech Riff
topline_melody.contour_type: Aggressive, high-resonance acid filter sweeps with staccato accent screams
topline_melody.vocoder_elements: Vocal samples bitcrushed, pitch-shifted down an octave, and gated into rhythmic 16th-note stutter mantras.

bass_groove.title: Distorted 4-on-the-Floor Electro-Punk Saw
bass_groove.patch: Dual saw wave through Pro-Co Rat distortion pedal & Korg MS-20 resonant low-pass filter
bass_groove.pocket: Inelastic, machine-like 16th-note stabs with micro-gate lengths (25-35%) locked strictly to a hard-clipped TR-909 kick.

timbral_profile.tape_saturation: Extreme analog console overdrive (Mackie 1604 VLZ channel drive pushed to square clipping), ChowTape high-drive saturation.
timbral_profile.hardware_gear: Roland TB-303, Korg MS-20, Roland TR-909 overdriven, Pro-Co Rat distortion pedal, Boss BF-2 Flanger.
timbral_profile.spatial_acoustics: Bone-dry claustrophobic industrial space; no long reverbs, only short metallic slapback delays.

macro_structure.buildup_mechanism: Filter cutoff sweep raising the scream of the 303 acid lead; abrupt 1-bar total mute on bar 16 beat 4; devastating drop.

artists.name: SebastiAn
artists.subgenre: French Electro / Ed Banger Sound / Complextro
artists.billboard_peak: Ed Banger Records pioneer; producer for Frank Ocean (*Blonde*), Charlotte Gainsbourg; multi-platinum European electronic innovator.

harmonic_progression.title: Embody
harmonic_progression.roman_numerals: Imaj7 - IVmaj7 - vi7 - V11 (French Touch Funk Masterclass)
harmonic_progression.analysis: Combines 70s Philadelphia soul and disco string voicings with violent, micro-edited French electro distortion cuts.

topline_melody.title: Embody Chopped Soul Vocal / Funk Synth
topline_melody.contour_type: Micro-chopped funk vocal syllables with syncopated blues-scale pitch scoops
topline_melody.vocoder_elements: Micro-sliced soul record vocals with 64th-note repeat glitzy stutter edits.

bass_groove.title: Hyper-Compressed Ed Banger Slap Bass
bass_groove.patch: Slapped Fender Jazz bass heavily saturated and gated, doubled with square sub
bass_groove.pocket: The definitive Ed Banger slap bass: hyper-compressed thumb slaps, popping octaves, and extreme sidechain pumping ducking 18dB.

timbral_profile.tape_saturation: Alesis 3630 compressor slammed into analog distortion; ChowTape driving saturation into biting transients; Akai MPC 12-bit sampler crunch.
timbral_profile.hardware_gear: Akai MPC2000XL, Ensoniq Mirage, Korg MS-20, Boss distortion pedals, vintage disco vinyl soundbites.
timbral_profile.spatial_acoustics: Mono dry core for bass and drums; explosive sidechained plate reverb on disco string stabs.

macro_structure.buildup_mechanism: Instantaneous cut-ups from brutal distorted electro into lush romantic 70s strings; false drop with tape-brake turnaround.

artists.name: Digitalism
artists.billboard_peak: Billboard Top Electronic/Dance Albums top 15; global festival headliners; sync placement on FIFA, Need for Speed, and major films.

harmonic_progression.title: Zdarlight / Pogo
harmonic_progression.roman_numerals: i - bVI - bVII - v (Motorik Indie-Electro Cadence)
harmonic_progression.analysis: Anthemic, driving indie-dance chord progression. Creates unrelenting forward momentum through the stepwise bass descent from bVII (A) down to v (F#m).

topline_melody.title: Zdarlight Iconic Ascending Arpeggio Lead
topline_melody.contour_type: Ascending 3-note motorik arpeggio motif in continuous 16th notes
topline_melody.vocoder_elements: In 'Pogo', catchy indie-rock punk-style vocals doubled with bright sawtooth synths.

bass_groove.title: Motorik Indie-Dance 16th Bassline
bass_groove.patch: Minimoog Model D saw + live electric bass through overdriven Vox AC30 amp
bass_groove.pocket: Driving 16th-note motor with strict 50% quantize and subtle accentuation on the 8th-note offbeats.

timbral_profile.tape_saturation: Analog tape warmth with ChowTape gentle drive; guitar amp cabinet emulation on synth busses to give rock grit.
timbral_profile.hardware_gear: Roland Juno-106, Clavia Nord Lead 2, Minimoog, Ludwig acoustic drums layered with TR-909 samples.
timbral_profile.spatial_acoustics: Bright punchy room reverb, wide stereo chorus on synth pads, centered high-energy bass and kick.

macro_structure.buildup_mechanism: Gradual 32-bar filter sweep slowly brightening the iconic 3-note riff; full rhythm explosion with driving live hi-hats.

artists.name: The Glitch Mob
top_tracks: Drive It Like You Stole It
We Can Make the World Stop
artists.billboard_peak: Billboard Dance/Electronic Albums #1 (*Love Death Immortality*); Billboard Independent Albums #4; 500M+ streams.

harmonic_progression.title: Fortune Days / Drive It Like You Stole It
harmonic_progression.roman_numerals: i - bVI - iv - V (Epic Heroic Cadence)
harmonic_progression.analysis: Combines cinematic film-score harmonic minor gravity with crushing midtempo bass grooves. The V7 resolution produces epic, theatrical grandeur.

topline_melody.title: Fortune Days String-Synth Riff
topline_melody.contour_type: Melodramatic pentatonic violin-synth motif with pitch-wheel vibrato and glitch chops
topline_melody.vocoder_elements: Vocal samples sliced into stuttering glitch-chops with automated formant filters and bitcrushers.

bass_groove.title: Midtempo 105 BPM Glitch-Hop Sub & Reese
bass_groove.patch: Distorted 808 sub bass layered with tearing mid-range Reese saw
bass_groove.pocket: Crushing halftime boom-bap / glitch-hop pocket: massive sub on beat 1 and 3-and, with syncopated 16th mid-bass growls.

timbral_profile.tape_saturation: Multiband distortion (Ohm Force Ohmicide) combined with tape saturation for tearing mid-range harmonics; sub-bass kept pure sine-warmth.
timbral_profile.hardware_gear: Native Instruments Massive, custom touchscreen MIDI Lemurs, heavy mechanical Foley snares layered with acoustic crashes.
timbral_profile.spatial_acoustics: Massive arena stadium reverb, gated snare reflections, extreme stereo panning on glitch-chops.

macro_structure.buildup_mechanism: Tribal live percussion and violin-synth build with accelerating snare rolls; sudden beat 4 silence before half-time monster drop.

artists.name: Cassius
artists.billboard_peak: UK Singles Chart Top 10; Billboard Dance Club Songs #1; 'I <3 U SO' famously sampled by Jay-Z & Kanye West ('Why I Love You' on *Watch the Throne*).

harmonic_progression.title: I <3 U SO
harmonic_progression.roman_numerals: vi7 - IVmaj7 - ii7 - V7 (Bittersweet French Disco Cadence)
harmonic_progression.analysis: Classic French Touch bittersweet soul loop. Employs 12-bit sampled vinyl chords with low-pass filter sweeps, creating an emotionally nostalgic dancefloor anthem.

topline_melody.title: I <3 U SO Filtered Soul Vocal Hook
topline_melody.contour_type: Soulful ascending vocal hook with pitch-shifted vintage warmth

climax.lyric: I love you so, but why I love you?

topline_melody.vocoder_elements: Pitch-shifted and formanted soul vocal sample (Sandra Richardson) running through an analog phaser.

bass_groove.title: Filtered French Touch Disco Slap
